name: NOVA mini arm drive B1+ (judge-final R2c): B1 drive + judge fixes + B2 column fill
frame: B: mm, Z up, front -Y, robot left +X. LEFT side values; RIGHT = mirror x -> -x (all checks both sides).

servo.model: Feetech SCS0009 / Waveshare SC09, ears cut off
servo.note: official drawing: 25.25 to the top face (bottom z -70.25), body shoulder 21.45; v2 model used 21.5 -> measure, see open items

coupler.type: printed cup + bonded trimmed supplied single-arm horn (hub D7.4 x 4.1, flats AF 6.2)

MR63ZZ_B1.seat: v2 tongue ring r 3.0..4.4, epoxied outer race

gear_18T.bore: printed M4x0.7 internal thread (+0.1 radial clearance), screwed on the M4 and epoxied (JUDGE FIX, was plain D4.1)

MR74_A2.outer: EPOXIED against the outboard shoulder at x 55.10 (JUDGE FIX: inward axial stop)

arm_shaft_M4x20.std: DIN 912 / ISO 4762 M4x20 8.8 zinc, fully threaded, major dia >= 3.93 by calipers
arm_shaft_M4x20.bond: Loctite 638 + activator on the A1/A2 zones; head set 0.5 off the seat end with a printed gauge while curing (JUDGE FIX)

plug_zatka.slot_6oclock: |y-3| <= 5.1 for x < 44.0, open to -X (JUDGE: 5.1 instead of B1 5.3; 0.60 to the pinion crown, 0.89 wall to the M2 inserts)

stop_lug.contacts: rib meets it at arm -51.0 deg and +140.5 deg (JUDGE FIX, two-sided)

plug_zatka.screws: 3x M2x10 countersunk at r 9.0, 12/4/8 o'clock, into epoxied M2 brass inserts in the boss
plug_zatka.pegs: 2 printed D2.4 at r 9.0, 10 and 2 o'clock

washer_DIN125_M10.bond: friction face set flush to a reference (hub face-down on glass), epoxy takes the thickness tolerance (JUDGE FIX)

drive_hub.magnet_pockets: 8x D5.1 at r 7.7, open outboard, 0.25 skin at x 62.6, depth 3.05 (magnet 2.0 + printed spacer 0.2/0.4)

clutch.magnets: NdFeB 5x2 axial N38, alternating polarity, typically 4-7 (2-9 possible)

homing: two slow sweeps at the running torque limit: servo to its low end (arm stops at -51, clutch slips), then to its high end (arm stops at +140.5, clutch slips); offset = known. Needs servo travel >= 287 deg.

column.base: v2 pocket column (C-channel below the deck, pad, snap tab, cable slot, web)
column.upper_fill: B2 colroom fill z -49..-27, bands y 7.5..16.5 and -21..-9, with JUDGE keep-outs: cylinder r 5.0 about (39,3) for z -44..-35, slab y -1.8..7.8 for x >= 34.2, z -44..-35 (coupler slide-in), r 3.0 above z -35; trim 0.1 at the T_paluba edge
